Subject: Vendor onboarding & PO requirements for Redwood Inference

Hi Rishi,

We are ready to get Redwood set up as a registered vendor in our system. Attached is our AP onboarding packet — it lists the documents we need to complete registration and our standard PO / invoice requirements. Please confirm which of the attached items you can provide and whether Redwood will invoice with VAT or zero-rate under reverse charge.

Key items we need filled out:
- Completed vendor registration form (page 2)
- Company registration number and VAT ID
- Bank details (IBAN + SWIFT) for cross-border transfers
- Tax classification (EU VAT / reverse charge / non-EU vendor)

We issue Purchase Orders for all SaaS contracts above €10k. Our PO needs to include: PO number, billing contact, invoice line items (description + quantity + unit price), and billing address. We usually pay within 60 days after receipt of a correct invoice.

I attached the packet: AP_Onboarding_Packet_Acme_Industries.pdf (pdf, 320KB).

Best,
Marta Kowalski

Hi Marta — thanks for the packet.

We can complete the registration and provide everything you listed. I’m attaching our standard vendor info PDF and a short checklist of which items we will return filled out. Quick notes up front:

- Redwood Inference is a US-headquartered company. Our VAT treatment for EU customers is typically handled as a non-EU supplier with VAT charged where applicable. For B2B across the EU, we usually treat the supply under reverse charge (VAT ID provided). If Acme requires Redwood to invoice with VAT applied, please confirm the rate and remit address.
- Bank details (IBAN + BIC) will be provided as part of the registration form; we can also provide an EU-based payout routing if required for faster settlement.
- We can accept a PO number on invoices; please confirm PO format (e.g., PO-2025-####) and whether a single consolidated invoice per month is preferred or per-PO invoicing.

Next steps we propose:
1) I’ll complete the vendor registration form and return it to you by EOD Monday (attached).
2) Finance (cc’d) will prepare a sample invoice that matches your PO fields so you can confirm it will pass your AP system.
3) Once you confirm PO number format and VAT handling, we’ll issue the first invoice to match your PO.

Attachments: Redwood_Vendor_Info_2025.pdf (contact details, tax IDs, banking stub)

If you prefer, we can complete the web registration via your vendor portal — just send the verification link.

Best,
